title: Returns Desk Matrix: Refund Treatment of Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
No activated card in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program can be returned for a refund. A card sold but not yet activated can be voided and its purchase refunded only on the types marked for it below. When a purchase paid with a card is returned, the value goes back to the same card on every type except the Northgate Promotional Gift Card, whose portion of a returned purchase is not refunded; and on that same type, returning the purchase that earned the card deducts the promotional value from the refund when the card has been used.

## Matrix

| Card type | Activated card can be returned for a refund | Card sold but not yet activated can be voided and its purchase refunded | Return of a purchase paid with the card credits the value back to the same card | How the promotional-card portion of a returned purchase is refunded | Returning the purchase that earned a promotional card deducts the promotional value from the refund when the card has been used |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | no | yes | yes | not applicable | no |
| Northgate eGift Card | no | no | yes | not applicable | no |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | no | no | yes | not applicable | no |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | no | no | no | not refunded | yes |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | no | yes | yes | not applicable | no |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | no | yes | yes | not applicable | no |

## Card state and the void column

| Hypothetical card | Activated? | Void and refund of the card purchase |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card sold, not yet activated | no | available, the type allows it |
| Northgate eGift Card sold, not yet activated | no | not available, the type does not allow it |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card already activated | yes | not available, an activated card cannot be returned for a refund |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card sold, not yet activated | no | available, the type allows it |

## Reading the matrix

- The refund-to-card column concerns the value a card paid on a purchase that is later returned, not a refund of the card itself.
- The promotional-portion and deduction columns carry a value only for the Northgate Promotional Gift Card; for the other types they do not apply.
